subtypes.prepare_artifact: 准备产物 request:{subtype:'prepare_artifact', path:<路径>}

event_model.sync_strategy: Y6.W1 六源: CACHE_RESTORE(Room缓存)→REST_FULL/REST_INCREMENTAL/OLDER_BACKFILL(分页回填)→SSE_INCREMENTAL(实时)→DERIVED_STATE(本地派生), 统一经 display_key 去重渲染
event_model.live_activity_schema: task_aggregate_v1: activity_kind, generation_id, operation(START|UPDATE|END), sequence, content{tasks[<=3]{session_id,display_title,state,progress{current,total}}, secondary_actions[REJECT|ALLOW], overall_state, total_count, active_count, hidden_count, compact_text, icon_key, primary_action}, attention{request_id, actions, expires_at}, completion_stats{files_changed,added,deleted}, machine_name, directory, fallback
